_doc: The trailer's voiceover: your grandmother, cast as she is in the game (voices.json writers.grandmother), over the trailer's own score. Each line starts at `at` seconds into the film (cut.py's timeline; tools/trailer/score.js MARKS has the hits it sits between). voiceover.py voices and places them; a line that would overlap the one before it is pushed later and reported.

lines.text: Do you remember the stories I used to tell you?
A kingdom under the hill. A king who sang badly, and a crown nobody could find.
You used to stay up far too late, the screen glowing in the dark.
You were nine when you stopped believing me.
Well. The house is yours now. So is everything under it.
And stay out of the dark.
The mist has come, just like I told you.
I kept the lantern lit for you.
